name: Nexora Lab
shortDescription: A self-hosted infrastructure dashboard connecting host telemetry, topology and administration. Open-source release-candidate work.
description: Nexora Lab is a self-hosted dashboard for understanding a homelab's hosts and workloads. It combines infrastructure telemetry, history, topology and administrator controls in one interface.
problemSolution: A host list does not explain how virtual machines, containers and physical resources relate. The project addresses that visibility gap: it connects changing metrics with the systems they describe, so an administrator can inspect a host in context.

name: Nexora Agent
shortDescription: The dedicated modular telemetry service that enriches Nexora Lab with node-local host, container, hardware, disk, and network data.
description: Nexora Agent collects information directly from a monitored Linux host and reports it to Nexora Lab. It complements the Proxmox API rather than replacing it.
problemSolution: A virtualization API cannot expose every local temperature sensor, service state or disk-health reading. The Agent fills those gaps while allowing unsupported collectors to remain unavailable without disabling the whole application.

name: CompressMe
shortDescription: A powerful, cross-platform image compression tool with a modern PySide6 GUI and full CLI.
description: CompressMe is a Python utility for reducing image-library size and reviewing duplicates. The same compression workflow is available through a desktop interface and command-line controls.
problemSolution: Processing an image folder one file at a time makes it difficult to keep settings consistent or see which files failed. A repeatable batch workflow also needs to distinguish identical files from visually similar images.

name: Jenica Salazar's Portfolio
shortDescription: A personal portfolio for Jenica B. Salazar, introducing her professional story, experience, skills, and MovieFlix venture.
description: Jenica Salazar's website brings her professional background and MovieFlix founder story into one responsive portfolio.
problemSolution: A résumé, certificates and a separate project story can be difficult to assess when presented independently. The website gives those materials a clear sequence while keeping résumé and contact access easy to find.

name: MovieFlix
shortDescription: A self-hosted, private media streaming platform delivering a Netflix-inspired experience from your own storage.
description: MovieFlix turns a local media collection into a self-hosted browsing and playback application. Its public case study explains the software without exposing the private runtime.
problemSolution: Media files need more than a directory listing: people need recognizable titles, artwork and playback that can seek through large files. Different codecs add another compatibility challenge.

name: Donut House
shortDescription: A premium cosmic bakery storefront with a rich product catalog, custom donut boxes, persistent shopping tools, and a complete demonstration checkout.
description: Donut House is a fictional bakery storefront that connects product browsing, customization and a demonstration checkout in one experience.
problemSolution: A custom box is more complicated than a single product purchase: choices need to remain understandable as items, quantities and options change. The design challenge is to carry those decisions from discovery into the cart without losing context.
disclaimer: Portfolio Commerce Concept — No real orders or payments

name: Mark Jaron's Portfolio
shortDescription: A personal portfolio for industrial engineer Mark Jaron R. Marigondon, focused on operations, process improvement, and measurable work.
description: Mark Jaron's portfolio presents an industrial engineering background through experience, selected studies, certifications and a practical toolkit.
problemSolution: A long professional record needs clear grouping so visitors can understand responsibilities and inspect relevant work. The site turns that material into a readable professional narrative rather than copying a résumé into one uninterrupted block.

name: Your Coffee
shortDescription: A responsive café ordering concept with 33 crafted drinks, flexible customization, local cart persistence, and a complete demonstration checkout.
description: Your Coffee is a fictional café website with a searchable drink menu, product options and a demonstration ordering journey.
problemSolution: A broad drink menu becomes harder to explore when customers also need to choose options. The interface brings discovery and customization together, while keeping the current order visible.
disclaimer: Portfolio Café Concept — No real orders or payments

name: Python-Keybr
shortDescription: A terminal-based typing trainer inspired by keybr.com, built entirely in Python using the curses library.
description: Python-Keybr is a terminal typing trainer inspired by keybr.com. It offers practice and feedback without a browser-based interface.
problemSolution: A terminal practice tool needs to show errors and progress without interrupting typing. The project also explores adaptive practice, where weaker letters receive attention and new letters unlock as confidence improves.

name: DistroZSH
shortDescription: A lightweight, framework-free ZSH configuration delivering a native, professional terminal experience across Linux distributions.
description: DistroZSH is a distribution-aware ZSH configuration with a consistent prompt and selectable layouts, without a shell framework or plugin manager.
problemSolution: Shell customization can accumulate dependencies and changes that are difficult to undo. This project provides a defined configuration while adapting the prompt's appearance to the running distribution.

name: Starbucks Login
shortDescription: An unofficial Starbucks-inspired login page demo — a functional UI concept with working form validation.
description: Starbucks Login is an unofficial interface practice project. The published demonstration runs entirely in the browser.
problemSolution: A login interface needs understandable fields and clear feedback when input is incomplete or incorrect. This small project focuses on that interaction rather than account management.

name: Smart Expense Visualizer
shortDescription: An interactive expense-tracking dashboard with Chart.js visualization — try it live right in the browser.
description: Smart Expense Visualizer is a browser-local demonstration for recording expenses and seeing how categories contribute to a total.
problemSolution: A transaction list alone makes spending patterns hard to inspect. The dashboard connects each entry to category totals, summary cards and a chart that changes with the records.
disclaimer: Live Demo — Data stays in your browser

name: Monthsary
shortDescription: A personal anniversary website connecting a time-together counter, a timeline and media galleries.
description: Monthsary is a personal anniversary website that brings photographs, letters and shared moments into one place.
problemSolution: Personal memories deserve a coherent presentation rather than a disconnected set of files. The design challenge is to make the story easy to explore while keeping its intimate purpose intact.

name: JohnVex-WinOps
shortDescription: A PowerShell administration toolkit with allowlisted operations, dry-run planning, verification and structured logs.
description: JohnVex-WinOps organizes Windows diagnostics and administration operations behind a modular PowerShell engine.
problemSolution: Ad-hoc maintenance scripts can make it difficult to understand what will change, what privileges are needed and what happened afterward. The toolkit gives those operations a defined planning and logging workflow.

name: J&GLO
shortDescription: A premium fictional streetwear storefront with an interactive portfolio store demo.
description: J&GLO is a fictional fashion storefront that combines editorial presentation with product browsing and shopping-bag interactions.
problemSolution: Campaign imagery and a usable catalog have different jobs. The design challenge is to preserve the fashion identity while making variants, sizes and the current shopping bag understandable.
disclaimer: Portfolio store concept — no real orders or payments.

name: ARKOSENYO
shortDescription: An architecture website demonstration presenting design, interiors, and construction.
description: ARKOSENYO is a client architecture website project connecting services, structured project records, search and image galleries. The published demonstration presents the implemented browsing experience.
problemSolution: An architecture website needs to connect project discovery with services and a clear inquiry path. I organized the client’s project material so visitors can filter work, open its details and explore imagery without losing context.
disclaimer: Client website project — published demonstration; inquiry delivery and a separate production launch are not asserted.

name: TAITECH Marine
shortDescription: A marine and industrial equipment website redesign demonstration.
description: TAITECH Marine is a client website redesign project for marine equipment and technical services. The published demonstration connects content browsing with a structured request preview.
problemSolution: Equipment and service inquiries need useful context. I connected category browsing with a request flow that asks relevant questions and lets visitors review their details before the demonstration confirmation.
disclaimer: Client website redesign — request preview only; no submission, scheduling or reserved availability is claimed.

name: Shoes on the Go
shortDescription: An independent 3D footwear experience combining cinematic motion and real-time interaction.
description: Shoes on the Go is an independent footwear visualization that connects a directed 3D narrative with hands-on product inspection.
problemSolution: A product presentation needs to show form and detail while still letting visitors explore it themselves. The project tests how cinematic scrolling and direct manipulation can share one model.
disclaimer: Independent, noncommercial concept — no brand affiliation or product sales.

name: ARCHÉON
shortDescription: An architecture portfolio demo with a scroll-driven 3D construction sequence, interactive house exploration, and illustrative tropical-modern floor plans.
description: ARCHÉON connects an original tropical-modern house concept with a reversible 3D construction story and interactive floor plans.
problemSolution: A finished rendering hides the relationship between structure, spaces and finishes. The concept helps visitors explore those relationships through staged assembly, viewpoints and room information.
disclaimer: Architecture visualization demo — Amihan House is an illustrative concept, not a completed commission. Project briefs are downloaded locally; no requests are sent.
